name: br.com.mrocigno.sandman.corinthian.json.JsonViewerActivity
description: This is part of Mrocigno's Sandman diagnostic toolkit. Sandman opens this screen when a user selects JSON from a captured network request or response, and formats it for reading.
disableEffect: The formatted JSON view will be unavailable; Sandman's request capture and the app's network connections are unaffected.
